window.title: {name} — {app}
find.move: Drag to move the search bar (position is remembered)
settings.title: Settings
settings.language.hint: Change the interface language. Every open window updates immediately.
settings.theme.hint: “Follow system” uses the current Windows light/dark setting and tracks it live; picking Light or Dark locks it.
settings.font.hint: {min}–{max} pt, in step with Ctrl plus/minus/0. Headings and code scale proportionally.
settings.lineHeight.hint: Adjust the spacing between lines in text and lists.
settings.width.hint: Fix the text column width and centre it. Widening the window no longer stretches text into very long lines, which reads far better for long documents.
settings.width.unlimitedTip: No line-width limit; text fills the window
settings.watch.hint: Re-render automatically when an external editor saves the file, keeping your reading position.
settings.window.hint: Keep the window above other applications; same as Ctrl+P.
settings.statusBar.hint: Show file path, encoding, size, line count and modified time along the bottom; same as Ctrl+/.
settings.links.hint: Ask for confirmation before handing an external link to your default browser.
settings.tabs.hint: Remember which files are open when you quit and restore them on the next launch. Restored tabs load their content only when you switch to them, so startup stays fast.
settings.reset.hint: Restore every setting above to its default; the theme also returns to “Follow system”.
status.noFile: No file open — press Ctrl+O, or drop a .md file onto the window
status.pasteEmpty: The clipboard has no text to paste
mermaid.unsupported: This Mermaid diagram type ({kind}) is not supported inline yet; the source is shown below.
dialog.externalLink.title: Open external link
dialog.externalLink.body:
Open this link in your default browser?

{target}
dialog.crash.title: {app} — Unexpected error
dialog.crash.text: The application hit an unexpected error, but it was caught.
dialog.crash.detail:
An error log was written to:
{path}
dialog.savePasted.title: Unsaved tab
dialog.savePasted.body: The content of tab "{name}" has not been saved. Save to file?
doc.largeFile:
Large document ({size})
There is a lot of content; layout and scrolling may be slow.
doc.noPygments: Pygments is not installed in this environment, so code blocks are shown as plain text.
error.isDir.title: Cannot open a folder
error.isDir.detail:
The given path is a folder, not a file:
{path}
error.isDir.hint: Point to a Markdown file instead, or press Ctrl+O to pick one.
error.notFound.title: File not found
error.notFound.detail:
This path does not exist, or the file has been moved, deleted or renamed:
{path}
error.notFound.hint: Check the path, or press Ctrl+O to pick the file again.
error.denied.title: No read permission
error.denied.detail:
The system refused access to this file:
{path}
error.denied.hint: Another program may be holding it exclusively, or it may need higher privileges to read.
error.readFailed.title: Error while reading the file
error.readFailed.hint: Check that the disk or network location is healthy.
error.keys: Keys you can use: Ctrl+O open another file, F5 reload, Ctrl+W close the window.
welcome.dropHint:
Drop a .md file onto this window, or press Ctrl+O to pick one and start reading.
Set this app as the default for .md and double-clicking a file will open it here.
welcome.pasteHint: You can also copy Markdown source and press Ctrl+V in a blank tab to render it right away; pasting again replaces the content.
welcome.scDesc.open: Open a Markdown file (in a new tab)
welcome.scDesc.paste: Paste Markdown source from the clipboard into a blank tab
welcome.scDesc.closeTab: Close the current tab; closes the window when it is the last one
welcome.scDesc.switchTab: Go to the next / previous tab
welcome.scDesc.theme: Toggle dark / light theme (locks it; stops following the system)
welcome.scDesc.pin: Toggle keeping the window on top
welcome.scDesc.zoom: Increase / decrease / reset the font size
welcome.scDesc.back: Go back to the previous document
welcome.scDesc.escape: Closes the find bar or settings panel first; otherwise same as Ctrl + W
